{{samename|volumes published in English by VIZ Media|List of Pokémon Scarlet & Violet volumes}}
The {{MangaArc|Scarlet & Violet}} of Pokémon Adventures is being separately collected into mini-volumes by [[Shogakukan]] in Japan. The volume releases began on February 28, 2024<!--, and later ended on July 28, 2023-->. Once the {{MangaArc|Sword & Shield}} ends in the regular volumes, the ''Scarlet & Violet'' arc will be properly collected in that format as well.
